briefHtml:
Portfolio Brief - Fri 2026-11-06 (SGT)

  • NAV: S$10,242,155, reported +0.54%; real day move approx -0.05% (S$-4,789 vs 10,246,944). First brief since 16 Oct - three-week gap; 16 Oct NAV restated up to 10,260,735.
  • Biggest mover: not in the book yet - US chips crashed Thursday after Asia closed (SOX -12%, NVDA -9%, SanDisk -22%, QCOM -19%). Asia digests it today.
  • The one thing: Democrats swept Tuesday's midterms (Congress + statehouses incl. Texas and Georgia); Thursday's crash prices slower data-center permitting and power approvals - a policy selloff, not a demand break. Oil war premium deflating on Qatar-mediated Iran diplomacy. 10y at 4.84%, 36bp through the 5.20% duration gate. NFP tonight 8:30pm SGT.

State and flags

  • riskFlags: ZERO - first clean day in weeks (pre-crash 07:40 snapshot).
  • L46.SI (Lum Chang): Yahoo 404, 27th consecutive session.
  • listedChgPct +3.18% unreliable - Asia closed before the US crash; expect give-back today. Nikkei -1.8% early Friday.
  • FX: USDSGD 1.2781 (firmer SGD vs 1.2841 mid-Oct), USDCNY approx 6.657.

Position moves (Thu 5 Nov Asia closes)

  • STI 5,296.25 (+0.52%). HK ripped post-midterms: HSI 24,797 (+3.67%, intraday 22,518-24,872).
  • Xiaomi 1810 HK$31.30 +8.83%; Tencent 0700 HK$430.40 +7.17%; SMIC 0981 HK$47.50 +2.28% (after +8.96% Wed; dipped to 41.06 Tuesday).
  • US Thu: Nasdaq -5.5%, SPX -4.4%, Dow -3.4%; VIX +70% to 28.18; Tesla -11% on Musk-scrutiny fears.
  • DBS Q3: profit -5% y/y S$2.81bn (missed); NIM 1.87% (-9bp); wealth fees +9%; markets trading income -65%; dividend 81c total. OCBC reports today.

Insider trades (7d)

  • Wing Tai (W05.SI): six consecutive Form 1 director-interest filings 28 Oct - 4 Nov for chairman Cheng Wai Keung; SGX's 2 Nov update flagged Wing Tai stake increases amid net institutional selling. SGXNet via ShareInvestor
  • No other held SGX names; no HKEX items for Tencent/SMIC/Xiaomi found. US ETFs - none by construction.

US Congress filings (filed 1-4 Nov)

  • House Republican (AK): BOUGHT Micron x3 (24 Sep-1 Oct, $1k-15k each), sold AVGO - disclosed 1 Nov, days before Micron's -17% Thursday.
  • House Republican (NJ-7): sold ABT/JNJ/MDLZ/SYK, bought ESAB/TXN (filed 2 Nov).
  • House Republican (OH-5): bought FMAO (filed 4 Nov). House Republican (MO-2): sold bank CD $100k-250k (filed 3 Nov). House Democrat (VA-8): bought CA muni $15k-50k (filed 2 Nov). House Republican (WV-1): sold HONA (filed 2 Nov).
  • Unusual Whales politics feed

Trump / policy watch

  • Blue wave - permitting and power-approval slowdown feared for AI build-out; Musk-linked names hit.
  • FOMC held 3.75-4.00% (10-2, two dissents FOR a hike); all 100/100 Reuters-polled economists expect a Dec 8-9 hike; Warsh: rates "get in the cracks".
  • Iran: Washington approved Qatar's draft MoU; feedback expected within ~36h; Tehran "interested but without concessions". WTI -8% Wed then +3% to $90.75; Brent approx $96-99 vs $116.72 on 23 Oct.
  • Metals: gold approx $4,010-4,130; silver settled approx $51.4-51.9 (-15% m/m; ATH $121.58 Jan). BTC approx $76k.
  • Singapore rates: DBS guides to "more supportive rate environment"; local funding costs drifting down.
  • Tonight: NFP 8:30pm SGT; ISM PMIs, BoE, EZ CPI this week.

Risk

  • IBKR silver line now the dominant risk: at $51.5 silver, collateral approx S$116,960 vs S$56,240 loan - collateral/equity approx 1.93x (1.77x on 16 Oct). Cushion nearly halved in three weeks; each -4% silver day cuts line equity approx 7.7%.
  • War-premium deflation removes the position's tailwind; reload window off the table until ratio below ~1.7x.
  • FX: ~35% of net worth non-SGD with SGD firming - translation drag. DBS concentration post-miss. VIX 28.18 elevated; NFP gap risk tonight.

Alpha (signals, not advice)

  • Defense/long-duration (TLT): 10y 4.84% is 36bp through the 5.20% gate; Fed paused; gridlock relieves term premium. Signal: NFP not hot tonight - start staged deployment toward the 15% target. ~62% of liquid book still idle cash.
  • Asia semis (SMIC 0981.HK): US crash is politics, not demand (TSMC +14% q/q guide stands; QCOM cites memory SHORTAGE). Signal: SMIC holds 41.06 week's low through today's gap-down - staged entry.
  • Silver (XAGUSD): do NOT reload into leverage at 1.93x. Signal: ratio under ~1.7x AND spot above $55 before any Real-assets add.

trumpWatch.title: Democratic sweep reprices the AI trade
trumpWatch.detail: Democrats took Congress and statehouses incl. Texas and Georgia on 3 Nov. Thursday: Nasdaq -5.5%, SOX -12%, VIX +70% to 28.18 on fears of slower data-center permitting and power approvals; Tesla -11%, SpaceX -9% on Musk scrutiny. Wednesday's +1,600-pt Dow rally fully unwound.

trumpWatch.title: FOMC held 3.75-4.00% (10-2), December hike consensus
trumpWatch.detail: Cook and Hammack dissented FOR a hike on 28 Oct. Warsh: 'interest rates get in the cracks... affect almost everything' - rates now biting the AI complex. All 100/100 Reuters-polled economists expect a hike at the 8-9 Dec meeting.

trumpWatch.title: Iran diplomacy deflates the oil war premium
trumpWatch.detail: Washington approved the Qatar-mediated draft MoU with Iran; feedback expected within ~36h; Tehran 'interested but without concessions' (Al Arabiya). Counter-signal: MS Now/Axios reported strikes could resume post-midterms. WTI -8% Wed, +3% Thu to $90.75; Brent ~$96-99 vs $116.72 on 23 Oct.

trumpWatch.title: NFP tonight, dense November calendar
trumpWatch.detail: US jobs report Fri 6 Nov 8:30pm SGT; ISM PMIs this week; BoE and EZ CPI. Later in Nov: FOMC minutes, US CPI/PCE, OPEC+ ministerial, US GDP 2nd estimate.

trumpWatch.title: Metals: gold holds $4k shelf, silver still -15% m/m
trumpWatch.detail: Gold futures ~$4,010-4,130; silver settled ~$51.4-51.9 after +5% Wed (52-wk low $46.88; ATH $121.58 Jan 2026). BTC ~$76k.

trumpWatch.title: Singapore banks week: DBS misses, OCBC today
trumpWatch.detail: DBS Q3 profit -5% y/y to S$2.81bn (missed S$2.96bn); NIM 1.87% (-9bp); wealth fees +9%; markets trading income -65%; 81c total dividend; 9M record S$8.82bn. Management guides to a 'more supportive rate environment'.
